title: Platinum Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document explains Credit Card APY bonuses for Rho-Bank Platinum Account holders when they hold eligible Rho-Bank credit cards under the same customer profile. It lists bonuses by card: Bronze +0%, Silver +0%, Gold +0.15%, Platinum +0.25%, Diamond Elite +0.35%, Eco +0%, Green +0%, Crypto-Cash Back +0% and states the bonus is automatically applied to Platinum Account earnings after meeting the criteria.
